name: mesioangular-impaction
description_template: A dense radiopaque structure with density and morphology similar to that of a tooth with its long axis mesially inclined to that of adjacent tooth. The mesial portion of crown is at the level of cervical third of adjacent tooth. The root formation is incomplete. The apical third of roots are in close approximation to inferior alveolar nerve canal suggestive of mesioangular impaction.

name: distoangular-impaction
description_template: A dense radiopaque structure with density and morphology similar to that of a tooth noted, the crown at the level of cervical third with its long axis distally oriented to that of adjacent tooth, root formation is incomplete, suggestive of distoangular impaction.

name: horizontal-impaction
description_template: A dense radiopaque structure with density and morphology similar to that of a tooth with its long axis perpendicular to that of adjacent tooth. The tooth is embedded inside the bone except the distal cusp which is at the level of occlusal third of adjacent tooth. The root formation is incomplete. The follicular space is increased. The tooth is in close approximation to inferior alveolar nerve canal suggestive of horizontal impaction.

name: vertical-impaction
description_template: A dense radiopaque structure with density and morphology similar to that of a tooth with its long axis parallel to that of adjacent tooth noted. The crown is embedded inside the bone and is at the level of cervical third of adjacent tooth. The root formation is complete. The follicular space is increased. The apical third of roots are in close approximation to inferior alveolar nerve canal suggestive of vertical impaction.

name: partially-edentulous
description_template: Partial complement set of permanent dentition noted, with missing wrt (tooth number)

name: periodontitis
description_template: The crest of the alveolar ridge is at the level of the middle third of the roots of all the teeth except wrt (tooth number), which is at the apical third of the root

name: generalised-attrition
description_template: Irt all teeth - coronally - flattening of incisal edge / cusps involving enamel and dentin noted s/o attrition

name: attrition
description_template: Coronally - flattening of incisal edge / cusps involving enamel and dentin noted s/o attrition

name: idiopathic-osteosclerosis
description_template: Ill-defined hazy radiopacity noted between the apical region of 11 and 12 s/o idiopathic osteosclerosis.

name: soft-tissue-calcification
description_template: Wrt laryngeal cartilage region below the level of hyoid bone a discrete radiopacity and a linear radiopacity noted s/o soft tissue calcification.

name: retained-root-stump
description_template: A root fragment is noted within the alveolar bone with complete loss of the coronal tooth structure, suggestive of a retained root stump. No associated periapical pathology is evident.

name: tonsillolith
description_template: Well-defined, irregular/ovoid radiopaque foci are noted superimposed over the region of the mandibular ramus, suggestive of tonsilloliths.

name: sialolith
description_template: A well-defined radiopaque focus is noted in the region of the floor of the mouth, possibly representing a sialolith. Correlation with occlusal radiography/ultrasonography may be considered.

name: calcified-lymph-node
description_template: Irregular, lobulated radiopaque calcified foci are noted inferior to the angle of the mandible, suggestive of calcified lymph nodes.

name: fixed-prostheses
description_template: A well-defined radiopaque structure extending from the coronal portion of – to – and covering the entire crown s/o fixed prostheses

name: surgical-staples
description_template: Well-defined, discrete multiple radiopacities noted on the angle of the mandible region s/o surgical staples

name: surgical-plate
description_template: A well-defined linear heterogenous series of evenly spaced round radiopaque rings that forms a chain like structure extending from --- with radiopaque cylindrical structures extending from the plate into bone s/o surgical fixation plate with screws

name: ryles-tube
description_template: A well-defined radiopaque tubular structure extending along the maxillofacial region s/o Ryle's tube

name: supernumerary-tooth

name: retained-deciduous-tooth
description_template: Well-defined heterogenous radiopacity with density and morphology similar to that of a tooth and comparatively smaller than the permanent adjacent tooth s/o retained deciduous tooth

description_template:

Periapically - ill-defined radiolucency with loss of lamina dura followed by a radiopacity suggestive of condensing osteitis
